description: Source code for LVPSA control functions related to bandpass filter configuration, coefficient calculation, and filter state management in an audio processing module.

methods.name: LVPSA_SetBPFiltersType
methods.description: Determines filter precision type (single or double) based on center frequency and Q factor.

methods.name: LVPSA_SetBPFCoefficients
methods.description: Calculates and sets bandpass filter coefficients for each relevant filter, using either single or double precision.

methods.name: LVPSA_Control
methods.description: Updates control parameters for the LVPSA instance, validating inputs and setting pending control flag.

methods.name: LVPSA_GetControlParams
methods.description: Retrieves current control parameters from the LVPSA instance.

methods.name: LVPSA_GetInitParams
methods.description: Retrieves initialization parameters from the LVPSA instance.

methods.name: LVPSA_ApplyNewSettings
methods.description: Reinitializes filter parameters and coefficients if sample rate or detection speed has changed.

methods.name: LVPSA_ClearFilterHistory
methods.description: Resets filter state data (taps) for all filters.
